title: Frozen AF-23 rule-ranking × STOP-gate factorial intervention on AF-25 Horn proof traces

frozen.graph_source: Unchanged experiments/activation_funnel_af25/gym.py from scored AF25 source commit
frozen.exact_budget: shortest physical Horn proof length plus one firing for provable, two decisions for unprovable
frozen.model: Eight original AF-23 final 6036-parameter ReadoutPolicy('ancestor',4) checkpoints, exact SHA256 ZIP/member and Torch/NumPy parity. Zero training or adaptation.
frozen.neural_source: Unchanged original AF25 transfer_planner and AF23 min-plus score_from_nodes; same original neural weights per seed across all arms.
frozen.host: All action firings legal under public physical Horn graph; model inference sees no BFS distances, reachability truth or optimal actions

nd.gate: Always continue while >=1 legal rule remains
nd.expected: Forced-continuation diagnostic, must report incorrect negative STOP

nv.gate: Always continue while >=1 legal rule remains
nv.expected: Forced-continuation diagnostic, must report incorrect negative STOP

action_rule.stop_choice: A chosen gate (Direct or VI-2) decides STOP by its own complete 15-action score vector, with original lowest-physical-rule-slot tie break. NO cross-head logit addition or rescaling. Its STOP decision is evaluated at each newly reached state.
action_rule.rule_choice: If gate chooses continue, choose highest-scoring enabled rule from the registered rank arm, breaking ties by lowest physical slot. Never choose an illegal rule or STOP while a rule exists under 'never' gate.
action_rule.no_legal_rule: All arms STOP when no rule enabled; reached goals terminate exactly before an extra action.
action_rule.full_rollout: Perform fresh complete closed-loop on chosen actions at all states, recomputing the *same* full two-step neighborhood and all original neural heads per decision for every arm. Prior AF25 saved traces never substitute for counterfactual rollouts.
action_rule.inference_compute: Record all actual scored boundary nodes, selected rule, gate STOP, both source scores, and each step's saved physical Bellman ledger. All arms share identical model weights; work differs because their reached states differ.

primary.endpoint: Proof completions on AF25 held_depth5 hard provable cases; 48 unique graphs × eight fixed seeds = 384 paired seeded episodes
primary.stop_recovery: count(dv solved) - count(vv solved), swapping to Direct STOP while keeping VI-2 rule ordering
primary.rule_recovery: count(vd solved) - count(vv solved), swapping to Direct rule ordering while keeping VI-2 STOP
primary.outcome_rules: STOP_ONLY if stop_recovery >=55 and rule_recovery <55; RULE_ONLY if inverse; BOTH if both >=55; NEITHER if neither >=55. INCONCLUSIVE on source/independent-replay failure. These are conditional in-gym attribution labels, not claims of general-purpose neural capability.
primary.interaction: Report (dd-dv)-(vd-vv) in successfully completed hard proofs, with paired per-seed and per-case win/loss transitions; never interpret additive causal mediation under nonlinearity.
primary.scope_note: The half-gap criterion was fixed from frozen AF25 published evidence, before any AF26 counterfactual scoring. Require original dd/vv parity against the original official AF25 seed and pooled totals before issuing any outcome.

secondary.depth6_hard: Repeat all factorial contrasts, including initial versus later premature STOP, on 48 positive hard goals/seed
secondary.each_full_depth: Repeat 80 provable and 112 unprovable goals/seed for both depths; separately publish 32 balanced positive cases
secondary.stop_quality: Report correct immediate STOP on every unprovable goal; forced-continuation diagnostic has no eligibility shortcut and cannot support STOP calibration improvement alone
secondary.avoid_pseudoreplication: Report eight seed-level paired counts and 48 unique hard graph cases. Pooled 384 outcomes share underlying physical case set; display 8/8 counts as seeded repeats.
secondary.controls: Compare dd/vv to source-verified original AF25 per-seed Direct and VI2 totals. No external symbolic comparison claims based on these six neural-only arms.
secondary.proof_soundness: Zero false accepted Horn proofs and exact original shortest proof budget for every episode
secondary.actual_work: Record source neural forward nodes, number of distinct host states and observed CPU runtime separately; no equal-FLOP claim.

audit.original_af25_aggregate: Download by fixed artifact ID; verify original ZIP and member SHA256; compare dd and vv exact per-seed/direct pooled totals.
audit.independent: Reconstruct physical rules from actual model-visible graph incidence, rerun independent BFS, verify every action and STOP, recompute original neural Direct/VI2 numerical scores, verify factor action, replay sampled frozen Torch forwards
audit.acceptance: Source-lock protocol and all code before scoring; copy no prior AF25 scores into new outcome; save every failure and scored per-episode row.
